errors.evidence: The description introduces the two categories being compared ("30个模型的平均值" and "30个模型的投票结果") and later mentions the two bar colors (浅灰色 and 深灰色), but it fails to explicitly connect which color corresponds to which category according to the legend.

errors.text_span: 图表中有两组柱状图，每组代表一个类别
errors.evidence: This phrasing is ambiguous and misrepresents the chart's structure. The chart is a single grouped bar chart, not "两组柱状图" (two sets of bar charts). Each category on the x-axis (1 through 10) has a group of two bars, with the color indicating the sub-category from the legend.
The statement that there is no specific sorting is incorrect. The bars are sorted numerically from left to right according to the experiment number on the x-axis, from 1 to 10.
